messages.text: just pulled the stage breakdown logs to double check the marginal gain numbers you wanted.
Great. Does the trigram+embedding baseline hold up against the full pipeline?
yep, 94% without the LLM vs 99.1 with it. that 5% is mostly ambiguous strings where the embedding score was borderline.
That is a strong argument for keeping the adjudicator. Did you test the smaller model on these same cases?
we did compare qwen3.8 to the 4B model. 4B was faster but had some weird false positives on junk strings. qwen3.8 rejected all of them.
Good. Accuracy over speed is fine for this use case, especially with local inference latency already tuned.
agree. one concern though: most of our test strings are still synthetic. do we have enough real user data yet?
That is a valid concern for the evaluation section. Have you collected any from the pilot sign-ups?
not many yet, just the ones Noor entered manually for testing. I can ask her to pull the actual strings from the seed list.
Please do. Even a small set of 50-100 real inputs would strengthen the human eval plan significantly.
on it. I'll get that sorted before the abstract deadline next month.
